answer: New identities start with zero reputation and pay an entry fee of 250 POA that only returns after 20 epochs of honest work. A copper attacker creating 25 accounts fronts 50000 POA in fees, and since reputation decays every garden window unless refreshed, fakes that rest lose standing fast. The mirror graph tracks who vouched for whom, so a cluster of new puppets all vouching for each other is flagged and their fees withheld.
